title: "Scoring Format Comparison"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: auto
---

```{r}
# Optional companion analysis. It deliberately does not duplicate production logic.
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

example <- tibble::tribble(
  ~format, ~reception_value, ~receptions, ~receiving_yards, ~receiving_tds,
  "Standard", 0.0, 7, 100, 1,
  "Half PPR", 0.5, 7, 100, 1,
  "PPR", 1.0, 7, 100, 1
) |>
  mutate(points = receptions * reception_value + receiving_yards / 10 + receiving_tds * 6)

ggplot(example, aes(format, points, fill = format)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "One football stat line, three scoring outcomes", x = NULL, y = "Fantasy points") +
  theme_minimal()
```

This document is optional and was not executed during Phase 0 because R and Quarto were not installed. Python remains the canonical implementation.
